cell_line.evidence: Proteins co-purified from asynchronous or mitotic HeLa cell lysates with a GST-MSP-VAPB fusion protein immobilized on GST-selector beads were eluted and in-solution digested with trypsin using the SP3 protocol (Hughes  et al., 2019, Nature Protocols, vol. 14, p. 68–85).
